description: Convert text to binary or hex and back, with full UTF-8 awareness and strict input validation.

faqs.a: Yes. Text is encoded and decoded as UTF-8, so emoji and non-Latin scripts round-trip correctly instead of breaking.
Each byte is 8 bits. A length that is not a multiple of 8 cannot be split into whole bytes, so it is rejected.
faqs.q: Why does binary input need a multiple of 8 bits?

faqs.a: Yes — spaces and line breaks are ignored, so you can paste grouped output like “01001000 01101001” directly.
faqs.q: Are spaces allowed in binary or hex input?

howto: Pick a conversion direction from the dropdown.
Type or paste your input — conversion happens live.
Invalid input (bad digits, wrong length) shows a clear error.
Copy the result or swap the direction with one click.
title: Binary and Text Converter
